title: `initialize`
description: The opening exchange in which client and server agree a protocol version and declare their capabilities once for the whole connection.
question: Does this framework complete the handshake and act on the negotiated version?
why: Statefulness starts here. Every capability the rest of the session relies on is settled in this one exchange, which is why 2026-07-28 removed it in favour of per-request metadata.
known_issues: Measured with the official MCP conformance suite 0.1.16, whose client scenarios are tagged 2025-11-25.
